newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Beirut share placement oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Beirut share placement oversubscribed.

text.p: Lebanon's Bank of Beirut on Tuesday closed a $10 million private share placement and a bank official said it was very heavily oversubscribed.
"We reached over $90 million," treasury and forex manager Najib Semaan told Reuters.

The proceeds of the private placement, which totals 20 percent of the bank's shares, will be re-injected as a cash contribution to capital on behalf of all shareholders, raising the capital to $26-27 million.

It will be followed immediately by the listing of 30 percent of Bank of Beirut's shares on the Beirut Stock Exchange. This is the maximum amount that Lebanese banks are allowed to list under a 1996 law.
Semaan said allocation of the share placement would take 48-72 hours from closing Tuesday and listing would take place between five and seven days after that.
Bank of Beirut will be the third bank listed on the Beirut Stock Exchange, following Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce and Banque Audi which listed in December and January respectively.
